name: World Legal Desk
tagline: The laws of many countries, as Markdown
description: World Legal Desk is a library of statutes as Markdown, one folder per country, from the public corpora that legalize-dev publishes. Agents search a country's folder, quote an article with its citation, and compare how two jurisdictions word the same rule. The library is a copy you keep on this computer: the app reads the folder with a filesystem server and downloads nothing. Point it at the folder whose country folders it should serve, and keep the folder in place while agents use it.

prompts.text: Quote article 1 of the German Basic Law from my legal library, with its citation.
Compare how France and Japan define a legal person in their civil codes.
Which countries does my legal library cover, and how many files does each one hold?

apps.name: Legal library
apps.description: Read and search the country folders of your legal library, over a filesystem server limited to that one folder.
